'''Hélène Bergès''' (born August 27, 1966 in [[Pau, Pyrénées-Atlantiques|Pau]]) is a French scientist and was the Director of the French Plant Genomic Resources Center from its foundation until 2019.

==Education==
Bergès completed a [[doctorate]] in 1995 at the [[Toulouse III - Paul Sabatier University]] in the fields of [[genetics]] and [[molecular biology]].<ref name="CNRS">{{cite web |url=https://www.cnrs.fr/fr/personne/helene-berges |title=Helene Bergès: Genomicist |author=<!--Not stated--> |date=2021 |website=cnrs.fr |publisher=[[French National Centre for Scientific Research]] |access-date=January 8, 2022}}</ref>

==Career==
After her PhD, Bergès joined the [[National Institute for Agricultural Research]] (INRA) in 1998, to first focus on research in studying plant interactions with microbes. In 2003, her position at INRA allowed her to found a separate department called the French Plant Genomic Resources Center (CNRGV) where she was the director until 2019.<ref name="CNRS"/> Employing some twenty people, the CNRGV is involved in various international sequencing consortia, develops various projects funded by the French Government (Grand Emprunt), the [[French National Research Agency]] (ANR) or the European Union, in collaboration with various laboratories all around the world.{{citation needed|date=January 2017}} Along other activities, Hélène Bergès is member of the scientific committee of the [[Parliamentary Office for the Evaluation of Scientific and Technological Options]] (OPECST).<ref name="CNRS"/> In 2021, she was one of the researchers highlighted in the " La Science taille XX elles" exhibition presented in Toulouse.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web|date=November 17, 2021|title=Hélène Bergès {{!}} CNRS|url=https://www.cnrs.fr/fr/personne/helene-berges|access-date=2022-01-08|website=www.cnrs.fr|language=fr}}</ref>

==Research==

|title=Combined effects of the signal sequence and the major chaperone proteins on the export of human cytokines in Escherichia coli |journal=Applied and Environmental Microbiology |date=January 1996 |volume=62 |issue=1 |pages=55–60 |doi=10.1128/aem.62.1.55-60.1996|pmid=8572712 |pmc=167772 |bibcode=1996ApEnM..62...55B }}</ref> and [[plasmid]] copy numbers.<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Bergès |first1=H |last2=Oreglia |first2=J |last3=Joseph-Liauzun |first3=E |last4=Fayet |first4=O |title=Isolation and characterization of a priB mutant of Escherichia coli influencing plasmid copy number of ==Awards and honors==
The National Institute for Agricultural Research gave Bergès their 2012 engineering award.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.echosciences-sud.fr/communautes/chercheur-e-s-d-occitanie/articles/helene-berges-le-genome-de-sa-vie-morgane |title=Hélène Bergès, le génome de sa vie |trans-title=Hélène Bergès, the genome of her life |language=French |author=<!--Not stated--> |date=January 29, 2018 |website=echosciences-sud.fr |publisher=Echosciences Occitanie |access-date=January 8, 2022}}</ref> She was one of ten recipients of the 2015 Vermeil Medal of the [[French Academy of Agriculture]],<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.academie-agriculture.fr/prix-medailles/medaille-vermeil-academie |title=Médaille de VERMEIL de l'Académie |author=<!--Not stated--> |date=2015 |website=academie-agriculture.fr |publisher=[[French Academy of Agriculture]] |access-date=January 8, 2022}}</ref> and she was given the 2018 "Outstanding Leadership Award" from the International Wheat Genome Sequencing Consortium, for "her leadership in BAC pooling and BAC libraries".<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.wheatgenome.org/People/Leadership-Award/2018-Awardees/He-le-ne-Berges|title=Hélène Bergès|publisher=International Wheat Genome Sequencing Consortium|work=2018 Awardees|date=February 8, 2019}}</ref> In 2015, she was made Knight of [[Legion of Honour]],<ref>{{cite news |author=<!--Staff writer(s)/no by-line.--> |date=June 4, 2015 |title=Légion d'honneur : Pierre Soulages grand croix, Sinclair et Bel chevaliers, Enders commandeur |trans-title=Legion of Honor: Pierre Soulages Grand Croix, Sinclair and Bel Chevaliers, Enders Commander |language=French |url=https://www.ladepeche.fr/article/2015/04/06/2081690-legion-honneur-pierre-soulages-grand-croix-sinclair-bel-chevaliers-enders.html |work=[[La Dépêche du Midi]] |access-date=January 8, 2022}}</ref> and she is also a Knight of the [[Order of Agricultural Merit]].
